fixes.before: a failed engine run (or an engine result without 'rop') returned 0.0, and an empty nozzle list returned 0.0 in2; the drilling tab displayed and then PERSISTED those zeros (payload keys avg_rop/hsi/tfa)
fixes.after: no value is invented: failure/absence returns None, a successful engine value is passed through verbatim (no 'or 0.0')
fixes.consumers_traced: tabs/w3_drilling_report.py (display + payload), core/database.py DrillingParameters.avg_rop is a nullable Float, canonical schema daily_report.avg_rop, kpi aggregation already guards 'is not None'

fixes.before: derived read-only spin boxes defaulted to 0.0 and the payload stored .value(), so an uncomputed ROP/HSI/TFA was persisted as a measured 0; loading a stored NULL restored a displayed 0
fixes.after: sentinel minimum + 'Not computed' display, payload stores None for an uncomputed value, a stored NULL reloads as unknown, a genuine 0.0 result is still stored as 0.0

fixes.before: the test created a bare QCoreApplication singleton; it stays alive for the whole pytest process, so every later widget test aborted (SIGABRT) with 'QWidget: Cannot create a QWidget without QApplication' - reproduced by running that file together with tests/test_m31_scenarios.py
fixes.after: the test bootstraps a widget-capable QApplication (reusing any live instance, falling back to QCoreApplication only where no GUI platform exists, with a loud message)
fixes.evidence: the repository already documents this hazard (tests/test_schematic_no_fabrication.py:416-424) and isolates its renderer test in a subprocess; this fix removes the cause for every test instead
fixes.test: tests/test_autosave_manager_regression.py + tests/test_m31_scenarios.py now exit 0 in the same process; full suite exits 0
mutants: covered by the reproduction: before the fix the pair aborted with exit code 134

fixes.before: QApplication.instance() or QApplication([]) silently accepted a bare QCoreApplication and the next widget construction aborted the interpreter
fixes.after: a non-QApplication session fails the test loudly instead of killing pytest
fixes.test: same file, used by every widget scenario

mutation_controls.restore: every mutated file restored byte-identically (sha256 before == after)

skips_are_external_only: test_packaging_smoke windows bundle (Windows bundle not available)
full_suite_after_fixes.environment: Linux headless source verification, offscreen Qt with fail-loud /tmp/qtstub shims; native Qt / Windows runtime remain NOT-RUN

open_items_recorded_not_fixed.item: w3 derived spin boxes keep Qt's default maximum (99.99) for avg_rop/hsi and the TFA field has no explicit maximum, so a legitimate value above the bound is silently clamped
open_items_recorded_not_fixed.why_not_fixed_now: choosing a bound is a product decision (no canonical limit exists in the repository); recorded as UNDER-REVIEW with root cause instead of inventing a magic number
